title: Iron Grip
wikitext:
{{About|the keystone passive skill|the support gem|Iron Grip Support}}

{{Passive skill box|Iron Grip}}

'''Iron Grip''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that causes the [[physical damage]] bonus to [[melee]] [[attack]]s from [[strength]] to apply to [[projectile]] attacks as well.

Taking Iron Grip causes strength to grant 1% increased physical projectile attack damage per 5 points of strength, alongside the melee physical damage bonus it already gives.

Effects that modify strength's effect on melee physical damage will also affect the bonus to physical projectile attack damage granted by Iron Grip. For example, {{il|The Iron Fortress}} grants {{c|mod|Strength's Damage Bonus instead grants 3% increased Melee Physical Damage per 10 Strength}} will also grant 3% increased physical projectile attack damage per 10 strength.

==Location==
Iron Grip is a standalone keystone near the center of the skill tree, on the southwest side of the Scion's starting area.
